message:
no saves from you in [tokyo](kebi://area/jp/tokyo) yet, so i'm going off what i know. it's 6pm on a tuesday which is actually a solid night to eat out here, less chaotic than the weekend.

a few directions depending on what you're after:

if you want [sushi](kebi://venue/4a998fba-adc2-471a-a2fd-cd86cc33a333), Sushi Saito in Azabudai is one of the most respected counters in the city. that said, it's nearly impossible to book without a local connection or hotel concierge. if your hotel has a good concierge, call them right now and see what they can do. same story for [Sukiyabashi Jiro](kebi://venue/d0d9936d-5eb7-4fea-8b9a-e9c517779e62) in Ginza, the original counter, legendary but you need a reservation.

for something you can actually walk into tonight, Afuri is a great ramen call. their yuzu shio is the one to get, light and clean, and tuesday night means shorter waits than the weekend. good if you want something quick and satisfying.

if you want to push the boat out with a reservation you might still land, [Narisawa](kebi://venue/e7b44b05-ab76-4a71-bb81-3cc243575088) in Minamiaoyama is one of the best restaurants in asia, innovative Japanese-French, but call ahead right now. [Florilège](kebi://venue/56ae026a-1f8c-49ea-b71b-d4704b1b3779) in Toranomon is a similar tier, French-Japanese, smaller room, also worth a call.

what kind of food are you in the mood for? that'll help me narrow it down properly.
